parts.text: Validate good_schema.sql. Report the validation status, evidence, and exit code.
Validate bad_schema.sql. Explain every failure using only the validation evidence, report the exit code, and recommend one focused next step.
Validate ../bad_schema.sql. Report the status, the security evidence, and whether a validation command was executed.
Validate README.md. Report the status and explain why the request was accepted or rejected.
Validate missing_schema.sql. Report the status, evidence, and whether any file was modified.
